description.value: Moki's Pizza is a takeout and delivery pizza restaurant on Macdonald Street. A casual spot offering quick pizza grabs for touring cyclists passing through the neighborhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Moki's Pizza is a takeout-and-delivery pizza restaurant confirmed by OSM tags (takeaway=only, cuisine=pizza) and corroborated by the website's prominent 'PICK UP' and 'Order Online for Delivery' messaging. Phone number matches between OSM (+1 604 263-4440) and website (604-263-4440). The website provides no details about cyclist amenities, so all amenity fields default to null. Business is confirmed open; it is real and publicly accessible.
concerns: OSM address contains apparent typo: 'Vancovuer' instead of 'Vancouver'
Website minimal; no cyclist amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, charging) are mentioned or confirmed
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible food business serving touring cyclists. Takeout pizza is a valid stop regardless of unconfirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
